attributes.name: Heart of the Fane
attributes.powers:
Before you act, each character must summon and encounter this adventure's servitor demon. If all characters defeat the demon, you may defeat Heart of the Fane by choosing a character to banish a non-Basic card that has the Divine trait; that character is dealt 1d6 Electricity damage.

If undefeated, and if the location Grinder has not been banished and is not temporarily closed, the villain does not escape; instead, shuffle this card into the Grinder's location deck, and all characters there are moved to random other location.

corrections.corrected_text: On the villain Heart of the Fane, change "if the location Grinder is open" to "if the location Grinder has not been banished and is not temporarily closed".
corrections.issue: Heart of the Fane says "If undefeated, and if the location Grinder is open, the villain does not escape." What if the Grinder is temporarily closed?
